name: Teleido
author: E. T. Carter
description: The archetypal kaleidoscope: a single wedge of soft jewel-light blobs mirror-folded around the centre and slowly rotated, so the figure endlessly reshuffles as the unseen object cell drifts through the tube. Jewel hues bloom on near-black with a faint rim of light running the mirror seams, brightest at the luminous core and falling to a dark rim.

params.label: Segments
params.effect: Number of mirror-fold wedges (floored in-shader); few reads as broad reflected sweeps, many as a fine jewelled star.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: How fast the whole tube turns; at 0 the figure still breathes from the drifting object cell.

params.label: Zoom
params.effect: Scale of the object cell — low zooms out to many small chips, high enlarges a few broad jewels.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Rate the glass chips tumble through the cell, driving how quickly the reflected pattern reshuffles.
